主要内容: CoorsTek, Inc., the world's largest engineered ceramics manufacturer, has announced its acquisition of Covalent Materials Corporation, a leading Japanese engineered ceramics manufacturer. The transaction, which is expected to close on December 26, 2014, involves a definitive agreement with the Carlyle Group and Unison Capital Group. The acquisition will expand CoorsTek's market presence, particularly in Japan and other key Asian markets, and enhance its research and development capabilities. The combined entity will have over 50 production facilities in 14 countries across 4 continents, with over 6,000 employees. The deal is expected to strengthen CoorsTek's position in the semiconductor industry, where both companies are major providers of advanced materials and technologies. CoorsTek has announced its intention to acquire Covalent Materials Corporation. As part of the transaction, CoorsTek will acquire the shares of Covalent Materials Corporation from its shareholders, making it the parent company. Upon completion of the share transfer, Covalent will redeem all outstanding bonds by February 18, 2015. KPMG is serving as CoorsTek's advisor for this transaction, while Nomura acted as the advisor for Carlyle and Unison. Covalent Materials Corporation focuses on leading-edge materials and highly functional parts, aiming to create unconditional value for society. CoorsTek, a global leader in engineered ceramics and advanced materials, provides solutions to global challenges in energy, transportation, information technology, healthcare, and defense. The acquisition is expected to enhance CoorsTek's capabilities in the materials sector.
